title: Filter Products by Category Using IN
description:
Write a query to return all products that belong to the **'Electronics'** or **'Furniture'** category. Return `id`, `name`, and `category`.

**Table: products**

| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| category | VARCHAR |
| price | DECIMAL |
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99), (2, 'T-Shirt', 'Clothing', 29.99), (3, 'Smartphone', 'Electronics', 699.99), (4, 'Chair', 'Furniture', 249.99), (5, 'Headphones', 'Electronics', 199.99), (6, 'Desk', 'Furniture', 399.99), (7, 'Jeans', 'Clothing', 59.99), (8, 'Tablet', 'Electronics', 449.99);
solution_sql: SELECT id, name, category FROM products WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Furniture')

test_cases.description: Returns 6 products in Electronics or Furniture categories

hints: `IN ('val1', 'val2', ...)` checks whether a column's value matches any item in the list — a concise alternative to multiple `OR` conditions.
Clothing products (T-Shirt and Jeans) are not in the list and will be excluded.
explanation: `WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Furniture')` returns 6 products: 4 Electronics (Laptop, Smartphone, Headphones, Tablet) and 2 Furniture items (Chair, Desk).
